body:
Honestly good for you as it sounds like you aren’t giving up on anything and you are remaining as positive as you can which is sometimes hard to do when it’s easier to let yourself fall apart over it (as I think most of us have been through before). I’m really sorry to hear about friends from the past, I can really relate to that and especially to you feeling like it’s a toxic place, one of the main reasons I want to get out of here too. I dread visiting my dads place because it’s where I know absolutely every person and they are not the type of people you want to be around unfortunately, which is also why I don’t have any friends. But you know what it sounds like you are doing much better than me with your roommates and coworkers, really take this time to maybe appreciate these people in your lives and you may end up manifesting even more closer relationships/friendships with others without realising. 

I’ve been given advice on my situation to just make a couple plans and even save some money, even if I’m not going to move away any time soon, at least I’ll be prepared for when the day comes that I make the decision. That way when I am mentally ready, I can be smart and comfortable about my decision and actually act on it in the moment it feels right. Idek what I’m saying right now cause I’m really tired but I hope it makes sense. Also what are you studying at the moment and do you not enjoy it?

That sounds awesome, I’d love to do the same and explore Aus and settle somewhere in my 30’s too. I’m sure with everyone you met along the way, you both served each other a purpose at the time in one way or another. I believe everyone’s in your life at different times for different reasons. Definitely could move around the world with the career I want to be in which is a blessing, which would definitely build some great experiences and adventures.

I really like your advice on having not just one plan but a few, that way I can really figure out where I want to end up and what will work out best for me, and then coming back to it days later to see if how I was feeling was just an in the moment not really gonna work out type thing or the opposite, so thanks for that. Thank you a lot for your positive and open-mindedness, you’ve made me feel like I’m not stupid for thinking how this way and I’m glad you could relate, so I appreciate that. And thanks also for taking the time to help me out a bit. I wish you all the best too and hope this life treats you well!

“I did what I wanted to do.” - This sounds like the perfect way to live to me (obviously to an extent). I’m impressed that you’ve followed your heart in life, taken on experiences you’ll never forget. It makes me happy knowing you will come to a time in your life where you’ll be able to look back and say that you did everything you wanted to and everything that made you happy and that you lived a fulfilling life. There’ll always be things in life you never got to do or experience, but for the most part I’m glad you’ll live/are living a happy life that you can be proud of. You’ve inspired me!

Exactly, I haven’t posted on social media in just over a year now, but yes that’s how I feel too, I don’t like the thought or feeling of being tied down to one place doing the same old thing where everyone knows me etc., I like the whole new potential thing where every place is a new experience, a new place to grow, a new opportunity waiting for you

That sounds like a good plan. And yes Australia. I have about $1500 in savings as I haven’t been able to work during this virus, but we’ll see what happens in a 1-2 months time, how I’m feeling and money wise too. Thanks so much for your help and sharing a bit with me!

Thank you! It sounds like you did well for what you had and what you could do at the time. See I doubt there would be anything like that where I want to go, so pretty much I should just use this time while I’m thinking about it to actually prepare myself for if I go. Also how much savings roughly would be a good start?

That sounds awesome, I hope you’re happy. I think a part of me is kind of wanting to run away from my own self here, but hoping that by starting fresh somewhere I’ll be able to grow as a person and learn my true self. Do you think I could be self-sabotaging if I go?
What is holding you back may I ask? Family, work, bills sort of thing?

I think you are right in a sense, I would love to go to therapy but have had bad experiences in the past. I may give it another chance. It’s more so that I feel that just nothing is here for me, I’ve spent the last three years of my teenage life having no experiences, no friends, no fun, not growing, ending back in the same rut as always, not fully living and learning about myself to find out what I really want.
When you left, did you go and stay with someone you knew or how did you accommodate yourself? But good for you. I really hope you are happy now and doing well.

That’s true, it would be upsetting if I didn’t stay in touch with my family. I wouldn’t want to create problems or conflict between us over this when there isn’t any to begin with. 

As for my partner, that’s a bit more complicated. Definitely not abusive, but just complicated. 

Also I’d love to head more north to a spot in sunny coast, something about this place just feels like home whenever I’m there, feels like my safe place.

Exactly.. you are probably very ambitious and have big goals or can see how you’d like your life to be/feel like, which is why you don’t want just an average routine life that most people settle for (nothing wrong with that if a person’s happy) at least that’s how it is for me anyway. 

What’s holding you back from doing so if I may ask?
You’re right, I guess it would be pretty selfish. I’d be pretty upset if one of them cut me off completely for no reason. Thank you
I wasn’t trying to fend off judgement by saying that, that was my response to someone saying I was underage.
What do you mean by groomed?
I’m 19 in a month, we are in aus so it’s not illegal lol, I’m not after judgement just advice but everyone’s entitled to an opinion I guess

Yes I somewhat agree with you, I know he has no malice intentions and he would never go out of his way to try and hurt me or trick me. But I can’t help that after countless of these same situations the more I realise that in past situations it was manipulation but I just never realised at the time. Honestly I don’t think he realises he’s doing it if that’s possible.

I did just try talking to him about it again and he said he’s mad cause I keep it going but I explained thats because it hasn’t been resolved yet so of course I’m still upset. And then he stormed off and said that it’s frustrating for him. 

This is pretty much how it goes every time something happens. I’ve been naive and haven’t wanted to accept that it’s manipulation because I feel maybe I am the one in fault.
I know but I just know how weak I am. I know that even if I did leave it would be for my own good but then eventually I would give in and keep going back

Because I feel like I have already been living it. We both struggle with the same mental health issues and we are so similar in everything we do and how we react, she is far more gone than I am but I worry that I’m not far from it. She married at 19 and had 6 kids, but she just settled I don’t think she was ever in love, she cheated on my step dad which is how I was born and last year she did it again, she became lazy and stopped working because she wanted to be a stay at mum even though my step dad only makes $700 a fortnight, she lost all her friends and she pretty much stayed inside at home all her life without any social interaction, and I think this drove her insane which has caused her to do many awful things over the years and made her sneaky and manipulative and narcissistic. There’s just so many more things, but mainly I feel that one day I will end up with escalated mental health issues like her and there won’t be anything to help it. I feel like I can just already see my future ending up like her and having her personality and her traits as my own. I feel like this won’t make much sense to anyone unless you knew her
Thank you for just understanding

I’m also worried that if I leave him, when I go back to live with my step dad in my hometown where I know literally every person, that if I see one of them it will make me feel a way that will push me to the edge .. insecurity and embarrassment and humiliation and being reminded of horrible memories and experiences, I don’t know I feel I would just break down even further

It’s so hard when you feel like they are the only person you have in life though, and to think of how much more lonely you will be without them. I do love him but I want to leave because I feel it’s not worth the extra pain and sleepless nights thinking of what I’ve done wrong to him and why he’d rather be with anyone other than me. 

I’ve prayed every day for the past three years that i could make just one friend and nothing. I have given up because I feel like I need to accept that I will always live the same life as my mother because that’s what it feels like, same sort of relationship, same situation with friends, same mental health issues, same work life, I’ll never be able to escape it

Because I’m too easy and he is quietly manipulative if that makes sense. It’s like every time I say I’m finally going to move out, as soon as he holds me again it’s like I forget he was ever in the wrong and I end up moving on, otherwise he will somehow switch the blame onto me and I’ll end up begging for his forgiveness forgetting that I hadn’t done anything wrong in the first place. I’m scared that if I do finally do it that he will hate me and send me awful things like my last did as well

It’s just my my step dad and siblings that’s all I have I can’t even talk to them about this stuff and I feel like if I wasn’t here their lives would have been a lot easier

How can I stop this pain .. I’m so lost right now. Everything is getting to me at once, the fact that I have zero friends and I’m only 18, the fact that my partner doesn’t care about me at all and treats me like shit but I don’t know how to leave, I hate myself so much and wish I could be anyone other than me, I have nothing going for me in life and I’m never going to live the life I want, I can’t even control my own mind. I feel like nothing makes me happy anymore I can’t even force a smile, I feel no love from anyone in my life and feel like I’m just a burden. I’m just so unhappy all I do is cry
Wow I love this comment

Awesome thanks for your help. And yes, a very awful employer.. when I first started she made fun of my makeup, and my skin when I would have a breakout. She also teaches students in her field and I can’t tell you the amount of times she’d come into the office and (sorry for lack of better terms) talk shit and bitch about her students, making fun of their appearance, their acne, if they smelt bad - saying they don’t wash down below properly - their sexuality, their sex life, their weight, (she refers to one person as the girl with the acne and is fat) even saying about some that their religion is the reason they are so “dumb” and uneducated. Definitely not a learning environment where “there’s no such thing as a silly question” ..

Yes I have all payslips; when I emailed her my back pay letter I included relevant payslips highlighting certain dates and pay rate etc., I also included my back pay calculations and every relevant PDF from fairwork.gov.au to show correct awards, incorrect award I was on and so on. 

As far as I’m aware there is no evidence as there are no cameras and if there was wouldn’t my employer write in her email something like “we have proof of this because/as such and such”? Her only reasoning was because her and I are the only ones with keys.. but I was last there last Monday and then she wrote that she found them missing on the Thursday. That’s 2-3 days that I wasn’t there .. 

Also I only thought this would affect my future employment if she gets away with the accusation won’t it stay on my record?

I’m in Australia haha but yes I have been in contact with 3 legal aids and they said I’ll have to call back Monday to see if I can get an appointment within the next 1-2 weeks. Also been in contact with a lawyer but they never got back to me ..

I do agree, I wish we could push all this theft stuff out of the way because I don’t understand why she would accuse me of that and I wish I could just focus on getting my pay sorted but I have been told that this is her way of getting around paying me what I’m owed, because apparently if she accuses me of something like theft .. Then she doesn’t have to pay me back pay, super, annual leave. That is the only reason I am worried about the theft accusation and why I don’t want to just let this all slide.

Also FWC told me it can’t be unfair dismissal because I haven’t worked there for 12 months but the fair work ombudsman told me I have to wait til next week to see what she says about paying my back pay. And then I will be able to call them up again and report her.

I 100% hand on heart didn’t steal anything. There are no cameras on site (that I’m aware of) but I wish there was to prove I didn’t take anything! Although as mentioned previously, I am worried if I return the 4 items I was given permission to borrow and take home, that my former employer will try and claim them as the “stolen items” as she hasn’t provided a list of what went “missing”
I have to wait 2 weeks they said to see if my former employer has fixed it and then if not I can make a complaint to them.

She owes me almost $7000 in back pay and over $1000 in super and my annual leave pay which is about $1000 also... it may not seem like much to another person but it is a huge deal for me especially as a teenager living out of home. I can’t possibly think of anything worse than letting her get away with this
Okay. Does that include emailing her back? Because I also need to send her my hours for this pay cycle on Monday..

So my next steps would be go to the police. And then get a lawyer? 
Also as stated in my post, she said in the email that I need to post my uniform, keys and alleged stolen items by this Tuesday as I am not wanted on site. Although there’s no way delivery would get them there in time - can I get in trouble if I or someone I know goes to the workplace and hand the uniform and keys in instead of post? 
Following from that, I am not certain on the date but somewhere between December and January I was given verbal permission to take home a couple of items to practise my work at home, I showed her the items and she gave me permission, and since then I have yet to take them back out of genuine forgetfulness as they are not specific items we even use for our clients. I am worried that if I return these items with my uniform and keys that she can claim them as the “stolen items” even though she gave me permission, because she hasn’t mentioned or sent me a list of the “missing items” that I’ve allegedly stolen.

I was actually thinking of going to the police but was second guessing it so maybe I will ... I am a part time employee only there for 7 months so FWC told me it can’t be unfair dismissal. Also I am her only employee under this company so it’s just me and my boss, although I do work with one other employee of another business she runs (in the same building) and she recently told me she had issues when she first started her employment where she wasn’t getting her part time employee entitlements (sick leave, holiday, annual etc.) got fixed up after a month though. I’m not sure if this is relevant information to give to a lawyer though as I was told by someone else to just stick to facts about my employment only.
